cycles.focus: External OSINT amplification of data-detective's D10 finding: Akin Gump's LDA-disclosed foreign-affiliated engagements (Ant Group, TP-Link Systems, Adani North America, United Solar Polysilicon) not matched by firm-level FARA registrations. Priority: verify attorney-level FARA, characterize each engagement's regulatory context, identify the strongest 'gap should not exist' case.

gaps_resolved: Whether Akin Gump has any FARA registration covering Ant Group, TP-Link, Adani, or United Solar — answered NO at both firm and attorney level (F1, F2).
Whether Akin Gump's Adani engagement was crisis-management response to the indictment — answered YES, retained 11/21/2024 immediately following 11/20/2024 indictment (F3).

What specific national-security review each engagement targets — answered: TP-Link = ITC Exclusion + Commerce ban review (F5); United Solar = Section 232 polysilicon investigation (F4); Adani = post-indictment State/White House lobbying (F3); Ant Group = unclear from filing text alone.

cycles.notes: Strongest 'gap should not exist' case is the ADANI engagement: retained day after federal indictment of the foreign-parent's executives, with lobbying directed at White House + State + Commerce on bilateral 'U.S.-India renewable energy cooperation' — a topic that is intrinsically state-policy and not bona-fide-commerce. The Adani Enterprises Limited parent is the named foreign entity of interest, and the LDA-disclosed lobbying targets only the executive branch, not Congress on trade/regulatory matters. Strongest 'gap is legitimately structural' case is TP-LINK: the LDA client is a Delaware/California-incorporated US subsidiary, the lobbying issue is a specific ITC Section 337 exclusion order (a commercial defense), and the ultimate foreign parents are private-corporate not state. UNITED SOLAR sits between: the Section 232 trade investigation is a regulatory matter (defensible LDA-only) BUT the chairman's Daqo/Xinjiang Daqo lineage and the IFC vote against the project by US Treasury make it the most reputationally exposed. ANT GROUP is the least-amplified externally — Akin Gump filed but the LD-2 issue text is empty in the rendered print; needs LD-1 retrieval. OS-002 should be PROMOTED to a full data-detective finding: the firm-level FARA absence is empirically verified at high confidence, two engagements (Adani, United Solar) have independent press corroboration, and the structural question (which engagements legitimately trigger FARA vs. don't) has a clear journalistic story arc.
